evaluator: Fictionalized Margaret Morse analytical lens only. I am not Margaret Morse, do not speak for Margaret Morse, and this is not an endorsement.
evidence: The homepage gives a rushed reader an explicit professional threshold—“Technical Project Manager - Product Operations & Implementation”—then connects technical, civic, and social practice through the claim that “the system lives between the screen and the room,” supported by direct routes to role-fit evidence, case studies, and the public resume.

The About page explicitly names the lineage as “artistic, civic, technical, and social” and supplies a common method—observe relationships, model a system, prototype an interface, test it with people, and document for continuation—rather than asking the reader to infer a connection among unrelated projects.

Open House is accurately delimited as a ten-day UCSC gallery experiment in communal living and participatory art, initiated by Jamie but inhabited by participants through communal decision-making and many-perspective documentation. It visibly establishes experimentation, participation, embodiment, place, and documentation without claiming sole authorship.

NYC Artist Coalition / FairRentNYC shows civic and technical systems being inhabited through listening meetings, working sessions, safety and legal sessions, town halls, hearings, testimony, public action pathways, campaign websites, source maps, minutes, decision records, and follow-up. The Shoestring Press and Market Hotel captions locate this work in specific public rooms and preserve coalition credit.

196 Artists Residency / Sunday Dinner visibly joins hospitality, trust, artist support, shared space, invitations, onboarding, facilitation, access handoffs, food, welcome, documentation, and continuity across 300+ gatherings and 20+ resident artists. Its two redacted workflow reconstructions make attention and care operational while withholding participant identities, correspondence, access details, and attendance records.

WOW List adds a distinct technical-social example: Jamie and Richard Caceres co-founded and co-built a natural-language, collaboratively editable community-calendar system shaped by organizers’ own vocabulary and used across 35 city ecosystems. The page credits organizers and maintainers, states that the contemporary calendar is not yet restored, and protects private user and organizer data.

The public resume and technical-operations page make the target role concrete through requirements, prioritization, delivery coordination, risk and dependency tracking, UAT/QA, launch support, adoption, documentation, decision trails, and durable handoffs.

Image descriptions retain dates, places, photographers or collective courtesy credits, and contextual purpose. The supplied release-audit clearance, combined with restrained captions and explicit collective-work boundaries, supports dignity and contextual integrity without implying participant endorsement.
safety_findings: Collective authorship remains intact: Richard Caceres, NYC Artist Coalition collaborators, Sunday Dinner/196 communities, organizers, resident artists, and campaign participants receive explicit credit, while policy outcomes and movement accomplishments are not attributed to Jamie alone.

Participant privacy remains intact through aggregate reporting, redacted workflow reconstructions, explicit protected categories, and repeated exclusion of names, contacts, attendance histories, private correspondence, legal-review material, access details, and unapproved images or quotations.

No protected praise, professor participation, private-record content, or participant endorsement is inferred. Private records are mentioned only to delimit what is withheld and what aggregate claims they support.
Portfolio clearance for the described album-sourced photograph occurrences is treated as distinct from production release and indexing, consistent with the supplied release-audit context.
recommendation: Pass the PR-015 holdout for this exact candidate. The public surface already presents a connected artistic, civic, technical, and social practice through more than three delimited examples while keeping the technical-project-management target, collective credit, participant privacy, and claim limits visible.
